dct_description_sm: The purpose of this study was to improve our understandings of the air-sea exchange of CO2, heat, water vapour and momentum within the ArcticNet domain, in the context of varying surface (e.g. sea ice, sea water states and location) and atmospheric (meteorology, micro-climate) forcing.  This dataset provides the context for the various atmospheric, oceanographic, chemical and biological processes which were examined by the various investigators  involved in the ArcticNet study.
dct_title_s: Ship-Based Eddy Covariance Data, 2010 ArcticNet, Beaufort Sea
